workflow: Production cad-core TRIM output is exported through cad-dxf and KDRAW1, then read independently with strict DXF parsing and base64/checksum validation. The fixture covers line, polyline, arc, ellipse and rational SPLINE results plus atomic Undo.
result: Independent read-back matched all result handles, entity kinds, geometry, layers, appearances, bulges, widths, ellipse parameters and SPLINE degree/control points/knots/weights without skipped or mismatched fields; KDRAW1 and DXF byte hashes matched and Undo restored the source revision.
